topic: Is the Cat Bells walk in the Lake District open all year, and how long does the main route take?

@claude is cat bells open year round and roughly how long does the main route take

Catbells is an open fell, and I didn't find any page saying it closes in winter. I couldn't confirm that, though. The seasonal part is transport: the Honister Rambler bus is listed as running March to November, and one source says Easter to October. The main loop is about 3.5 miles and takes roughly 2 to 3 hours. Check the weather and the bus and boat times before you go.

Sources: https://keswick.org/what-to-do/walking-routes/catbellswalkingroute
